ruling_horses_town.title: Ruling Horses Town (WIP)
ruling_horses_town.expanded_description:
Genre: Management / Choice-Based
Platforms: Windows
Release Date: In development

As mayor of HorsesTown's chaotic city, navigate political decisions to survive your term — because nothing can go wrong... for your mandate.

valquiria.title: Valquíria
valquiria.expanded_description:
Genre: HD2D RPG
Platforms: Windows
Release Date: Apr 24, 2023

A Viking-themed HD2D RPG made as the final project for the Game Design degree at SENAC-SP.

error120.title: ERROR120
error120.expanded_description:
Genre: Multiplayer / Tag
Platforms: Windows
Release Date: Nov 25, 2022

A fast-paced, radioactive multiplayer tag game. Feel the power of the hunter and the adrenaline of the survivor as you chase or evade in a vibrant, post-apocalyptic arena.

slimes_shields.title: Slimes & Shields: Bad Campaign
slimes_shields.expanded_description:
Genre: Roguelike
Platforms: Windows
Release Date: Jun 07, 2022

A comical roguelike about a kidnapped Slime forced by a Dungeon Master to play his worst campaign: Slimes & Shields. Die, upgrade, and survive infinite runs where you are only allowed to use a shield.

astrotag.title: Astrotag
astrotag.expanded_description:
Genre: Sports / Tag
Platforms: Windows, Android, Web (HTML5)
Release Date: Released

Step into the shoes of Dithos Andromeda, a former racer forced back into the cosmic arena! Compete in the high-stakes Enercup, the galaxy's largest astrotag tournament, to pay off mounting debts in this thrilling space racing simulation.

onomos.title: Onomos
onomos.expanded_description:
Genre: Racing / Betting
Platforms: Windows
Release Date: Jun 12, 2021

Welcome to the great Onomos Race. Buy, bet, and cheat your way to riches in this high-stakes betting and racing game. Bankruptcy is only a temporary setback—you can always try again!

casa_dos_ushers.title: A Casa dos Ushers
casa_dos_ushers.expanded_description:
Genre: Mystery / Visual Novel
Platforms: Windows
Release Date: Dec 04, 2020

A haunting Visual Novel based on Edgar Allan Poe's classic tale. Journey to a secluded mansion after receiving a distress call, only to become entangled in a terrifying and deeply unsettling mystery.
